report_name: Boston Scientific Suffers Global Disruption from Major Cyberattack

identities.name: Boston Scientific
identities.description: A medical technology company that experienced a major cybersecurity incident on August 25, 2026, leading to a global network outage and severe disruption of its business operations, including order processing and shipping.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 4a3b1c2d-e5f6-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/cyberattack-causes-global-disruption-at-boston-scientific/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects command-line patterns for vssadmin.exe deleting volume shadow copies, a technique often used by ransomware to prevent system recovery.

indicators.name: PsExec or PaExec Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: PsExec or PaExec Execution for Lateral Movement
id: 5b4c2d3e-f6a7-4891-8cde-f12345678901
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of PsExec or its alternative PaExec, which are commonly used by threat actors for lateral movement.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/cyberattack-causes-global-disruption-at-boston-scientific/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1021.002
  - attack.lateral_movement
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\psexec.exe'
      - '\paexec.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of psexec.exe or paexec.exe, tools commonly used for lateral movement within a compromised network.

indicators.name: High Volume of Logon Failures
indicators.pattern:
title: High Volume of Logon Failures Indicating Brute-Force
id: 6c5d3e4f-a7b8-4012-8def-123456789012
status: experimental
description: Detects a high volume of logon failures (Event ID 4625), which could indicate a brute-force or password spraying attack.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/cyberattack-causes-global-disruption-at-boston-scientific/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1110
  - attack.credential_access
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4625
  condition: selection | count() > 20 by SourceNetworkAddress within 5m
indicators.description: Detects a high volume of Windows Event ID 4625 (logon failures), which can be an indicator of brute-force or password spraying attempts against accounts.

indicators.name: Anomalous Large Data Egress
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Large Data Egress to Cloud Storage
id: 7d6e4f5a-b8c9-4123-8ef0-234567890123
status: experimental
description: Detects unusually large data transfers to known cloud storage providers, which may indicate data exfiltration prior to a ransomware attack.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/cyberattack-causes-global-disruption-at-boston-scientific/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host|contains:
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'dropbox.com'
      - 'drive.google.com'
  timeframe: 1h
  condition: selection | count(bytes_out) > 100000000 by c-ip
indicators.description: Detects large data transfers to common cloud storage providers, which could be a sign of data exfiltration before a ransomware deployment.
